mapper.select: SELECT id, title, category, system_code, source, content, understanding, practice, conclusion, duration_minutes, learned_at FROM learning_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY learned_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, title, category, system_code, source, content, understanding, practice, conclusion, duration_minutes, learned_at FROM learning_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND system_code = #{systemCode} ORDER BY learned_at DESC, id DESC

INSERT INTO learning_record(user_id, title, category, system_code, source, content, understanding, practice, conclusion, duration_minutes, learned_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{record.title}, #{record.category}, #{record.systemCode}, #{record.source}, #{record.content}, #{record.understanding}, #{record.practice}, #{record.conclusion}, #{record.durationMinutes}, COALESCE(#{record.learnedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) RETURNING id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM learning_record WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
